I am seeing this film here in about an hour so my review will be up then. Until then feel free to talk about it in the comments

As promised here is my review:

I'm just going to jump straight in and talk about the cast. Tom Cruise is Tome Cruise so I really don't need to say much about him because we all know what expect. He was amazing and his stunts were over he top, as we all expected. I was so happy to see the return of Simon Pegg and see him take on a bit larger part. He's the perfect mix of funny and serious in just about everything he's in. This is of course no different as he comes back as Benji, the tech expert. I would argue he's actually the secondary character in this above Rebecca Ferguson. He's what you come to expect from Simon Pegg and he always pulls it off so well. Rebecca Ferguson was my main worry with this movie. She's basically a nobody and here she is in this huge franchise. My fears have really been put to rest as she really did amazing. Her character is so well written and she keeps you guessing for the first half of the movie who she is and what she's doing. So many twist and turns in her character and she really pulls it off. Renner and Rhames were good as usual and the addition of Alec Baldwin was very good as well. Now a usual problem in Mission Impossible is the villains. With the exception of Phillip Seymour Hoffman in 3 they are almost all forgettable. Not the case with Sean Harris who plays Lane. He really feels like an old time Bond villain and that's just what this franchise needs. He was always 2 steps ahead of everyone and proves to be an incredible adversary for Hunt and the entire IMF.

I honestly can't decide if I prefer this one over Ghost Protocol. They are toe to toe and I can't decide. This one starts off with what will probably be the stunt everyone will talk about for years to come (and already are thanks to the trailer) and from there everything kicks up a notch. From your start to finish you are on the edge of your seat wondering what will happen next. Like I said above some of this goes to Rebecca Ferguson's character Ilsa who keeps you guessing. But even more of it goes to the tense situations they out these characters through. The underwater scene kept me anxious the entire way through trying to figure out how it would be resolved, then hits you with another twist that you don't see coming after Hunt is saved. Of course the chase scenes were amazing, especially the car chase that turns into a motorcycles chase.

Overall I loved this movie and was happy to see how good it was. It was intense and kept you guessing till the end. The cast was really the icing on the cake as everyone really brought everything they could to their characters. And of course a menacing bad guy who is always ahead of you always helps too. I have to give this movie a 9/10. Probably rank it as my second favourite of the summer and third of the year. Excited to see what they will bring to MI6.
